title: Engine: an uncategorized refund months later leaves the rollover's set-aside stranded (envelope, RTA low)
description: Found in the budget-xxpr review, deliberately NOT fixed there. A month's uncategorized card spending is capped by what the envelope does not already cover, charged at the rollover and added to the envelope (PaymentMonth.fromUncategorized). If a later month refunds that spending (uncategorized card inflow), the row nets down but nothing gives the set-aside back: the envelope keeps e.g. 50 against debt 0 while Ready to Assign stays 50 low. Points at client/src/domain/zeroSum.ts cardUncategorized + the payment loop's fromUncategorized carry; needs a rule that releases (or re-points) set-aside money when the row shrinks in a later month.
